# Lantern

> Lantern is a fast, 100% on-device semantic search engine for macOS built specifically for Apple Silicon. It indexes files, code definitions, PDFs (including scanned OCR), photos, audio/video recordings, apps, System Settings, shortcuts, and music libraries, making them searchable by meaning and keywords without cloud telemetry.

Lantern runs locally on macOS using a native Swift menu bar application and a Python background daemon communicating over a local Unix domain socket. It features deep integrations with Raycast and Alfred, and includes a full-featured CLI.

## Core Documentation

- [Getting Started & Installation](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/install/): System requirements (macOS 14.0+, Apple Silicon), Homebrew tap, DMG download, and building from source.
- [How Search Works](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/search/): Hybrid retrieval combining BM25 keyword matching and dense vector embeddings (bge-m3 / bge-small) using SQLite and sqlite-vec.
- [App & Keyboard Navigation](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/app/): Native Swift menu bar UI, search panel, instant preview pane, and key bindings.
- [Folders & Exclusions](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/folders/): Default indexed folders, .gitignore integration, secret skipping (.env, id_rsa), and custom exclusions.
- [Launchers (Raycast & Alfred)](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/launchers/): Official Raycast extension ("Search Lantern") and Alfred workflow integration.
- [Background Daemon](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/daemon/): Battery-aware indexing, thermal management, launchd service, and IPC protocol.
- [CLI Reference](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/cli/): Complete command-line interface documentation (`lantern search`, `index`, `status`, `daemon`, `vacuum`).
- [Architecture & Tech Stack](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/architecture/): Swift, Python daemon, SQLite + sqlite-vec, Metal, Apple Vision OCR, and Accelerate framework.
- [Privacy Model](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/privacy/): Zero telemetry, local-only vector database in `~/Library/Application Support/Lantern/`, transparent data erasure.
- [Known Limitations](https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/docs/limitations/): Apple Silicon requirement, current file size limits, and multilingual testing status.

## Technical Specifications

- **Target OS:** macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or newer
- **Architecture:** Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4)
- **Local AI Models:**
  - Text & Code Embeddings: BAAI/bge-m3 (dense vectors, 1024 dims) or bge-small-en-v1.5
  - Vision / OCR: Apple Vision framework (native Neural Engine acceleration)
  - Audio Transcription: Whisper models running locally on Apple Silicon
- **Database:** SQLite with sqlite-vec extension for vector nearest-neighbor search and FTS5 for full-text search
- **IPC:** Unix domain socket at `~/Library/Application Support/Lantern/lantern.sock` using JSON-RPC line protocol
- **Integrations:** Raycast extension, Alfred workflow, CLI tool (`lantern`)
- **License:** MIT License
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/misterekkk/lantern
- **Full Consolidated Documentation:** https://misterekkk.github.io/lantern/llms-full.txt
